changelog: - **Model list: the kind heading stays in view.** In the left panel's list, the heading of the kind you are scrolling through (Parameter, Pool, Gate and the others) now stays at the top of the list until the next kind's heading takes its place, so in a long list you can tell which kind you are looking at. A row reached with Tab, or brought into view by a selection on the canvas, shows whole below the heading.
